import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set the style
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

# Create a jointplot to visualize the relationship between megapixels and price, colored by sensor type
g = sns.jointplot(
    data=df,
    x='megapixels',
    y='price_usd',
    hue='sensor_type',
    kind='scatter',
    palette='deep',
    height=8
)

# Add titles and labels
g.fig.suptitle('Megapixels vs Price by Sensor Type', fontsize=16)
g.set_axis_labels('Megapixels', 'Price (USD)', fontsize=12)
g.add_legend(title='Sensor Type')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
